    Disclaimer & Privacy

    About Club AID

    Club AID (Accessible Information Desk) is Rockwell Club's online help desk for members and employees. It answers questions using the club's official menus, rate sheets, schedules and staff updates.

    Please Confirm Important Details

    • Menus, rates, schedules and promotions can change without prior notice.
    • Some answers are written automatically by AI and may occasionally be incomplete or out of date. Before booking, paying or making plans, please check the attached rate sheet or confirm with Membership Services.
    • Club AID gives information only. It does not confirm bookings or accept payments.

    Your Privacy

    What we keep

    • Your account: your username, plus the name, mobile number and email you choose to share.
    • How you use Club AID: the questions you ask, your ratings, and the pages and buttons you use, recorded under your account number.
    • Your chat history, so it's still there the next time you sign in. Tap Refresh to clear it.
    • The application, concern, feedback and account request forms are written for you and open in your own email, and you send them to Membership Services yourself. Club AID doesn't keep a copy of these emails. For account requests, Club AID saves only your name, email and mobile number. Membership Services uses these to create your username.

    Why we keep it — to answer your questions, manage your Club AID access, reply to your requests and improve the service. It is not used for anything else.

    Who can see it — only authorized Rockwell Club staff who manage Club AID. Staff reports show questions and totals only, never your name or contact details.

    AI services — to write some answers, your question and recent chat messages (not your name, username or contact details) are sent to an AI service. Please don't type sensitive information, such as card numbers or passwords, in the chat.

    Your password — please keep it private and don't share it with anyone. If you forget it, tap Forgot password? on the sign-in screen.

    Your rights — under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173), you may ask to see, correct or delete your personal information. You can update your name, mobile number and email anytime in Settings & More → Account. For anything else, contact Membership Services.

    Contact

    Membership Services: 0917-807-1739, (02) 7798-1700 or 45, or club@rockwell.com.ph.
